items.title: GET SIDEWAYS: WHY BLASTACARS IS KUALA LUMPUR'S ULTIMATE INDOOR ADRENALINE RUSH
items.content:
If you’re hunting for a thrill in Kuala Lumpur that blends high-octane motorsport with pure, unadulterated fun, Blastacars Malaysia belongs at the top of your bucket list.

Tucked away on the 5th floor of Sungei Wang Plaza in the heart of Bukit Bintang, this isn't your typical go-karting track. Forget racing lines and grip; at Blastacars, the goal isn't just to be fast—it’s to be sideways.

Photo credit: Blastacars Malaysia

The Art of the Drift

Unlike traditional tracks that reward precision and traction, Blastacars utilizes a custom-designed, low-friction indoor surface. Paired with specialized karts imported from New Zealand, the experience is engineered for one thing: drifting.

The concept was born in 1987 by Peter Zyp and brought to Malaysian shores in 2015 by professional drift driver John Wong. Over the years, the track and karts have been fine-tuned to ensure the experience feels less like a toy and more like a genuine motorsport discipline.

Photo credit: Blastacars Malaysia

Power for Every Level

One of the best things about Blastacars is that it’s "easy to learn, difficult to master." You don't need a racing license to feel like a pro:


Kid's Speed: Perfect for kids to learn how to drive in a safe environment.

Standard: For first timer (adults) who want's to experience the drift.

Expert: For those who have found their rhythm and want more speed.

Pro (420cc): The heavy hitters. Powered by Honda engines, these are reserved for skilled drivers looking for a truly intense, high-torque experience.


Why It’s a "Must-Do" in KL

Weather-Proof Fun: KL’s tropical downpours won't ruin your plans. Being indoors means the drifting never stops, rain or shine.

Prime Location: Located in Sungei Wang Plaza, it’s the perfect adrenaline break during a day of shopping or exploring the Bukit Bintang district.

Inclusive Thrills: It’s a hit for corporate team-building, unique date nights, or family outings. They even accommodate younger thrill-seekers (ages 6+ and at least 1.2m tall).

Photo credit: Blastacars Malaysia

The Atmosphere

The moment those engines roar to life, the energy in the room shifts. There’s a certain infectious joy in watching friends laugh through a "spin-out" or seeing a competitive driver nail a perfectly clean sideways line through a hair-pin turn. It’s all the excitement of professional drifting without the high stakes or intimidation.

The Verdict: In a city famous for its cafes and malls, Blastacars Malaysia offers something refreshingly raw. It’s a blend of arcade-style fun and real-world driving skill that will leave you breathless and inevitably saying, "Just one more lap."

Photo credit: Blastacars Malaysia

Plan Your Visit

Location: 5th Floor, Sungei Wang Plaza, Bukit Bintang.

Who can join: Ages 6 and up (Min height 1.2m).


Booking Enquiry : Call / WhatsApp +60199341349

items.title: GET TO KNOW THE TRAVEL STORE
items.content:
How It All Began

Photo credit: The Travel Store

The Travel Store was founded in 2004 with an aim of making it easier for people to shop, travel, and move through everyday life. Since then, it has grown to become a leading and preferred travel goods provider in Malaysia, with a strong brand presence in Southeast Asia.

Photo credit: The Travel Store

With over 20 years of experience and a community of more than 150,000 loyal members, the brand has built a reputation grounded in trust, quality, and a deep understanding of modern mobility. Whether it’s a long-haul journey or a daily commute, The Travel Store continues to evolve alongside the needs of travellers.

A One-Stop Shop for All Your Travel Needs

Photo credit: The Travel Store

As a multi-brand retailer, The Travel Store offers a curated selection of international labels such as LOJEL, Echolac, Eminent, Verage, and Hush Puppies among many others. Several of these brands operate their own factories, where products are designed and tested to meet strict quality standards.

Photo credit: The Travel Store

At The Travel Store, customers can shop for everything under one roof, and choose from a wide range of thoughtfully designed products—suitcases, backpacks, travel accessories, outdoor apparel, and more—that cater to different needs.

Photo credit: The Travel Store

Besides being an expert in travel solutions, another thing that sets The Travel Store apart is its after-sales care. The brand continues to support its customers long after a purchase is made, even allowing them to bring in other luggage brands for repair. This reinforces the brand’s philosophy of putting people first: Your Journey, Our Promise.

Encouraging Sustainable Travel, One Repair at a Time

Photo credit: The Travel Store

Sustainability is an ongoing commitment for The Travel Store, which is evident through its Earth Day initiatives that are guided by three pillars: Respect, Restore, and Reimagine.

Photo credit: The Travel Store

Photo credit: The Travel Store

Each year, the brand actively promotes mindful consumption habits and encourages customers to repair instead of replace their luggage. During Earth week from 20th to 26th April 2026, The Travel Store’s community of 2,837 participants have successfully sent in 4,070 pieces of luggage for repair, thus fulfilling the brand’s goal of giving your luggage a second life.

Earning Customers’ Trust With a 100-Day Return Policy

Photo credit: The Travel Store

Received your item but not satisfied with the quality? The Travel Store has a change of mind exchange and return policy whereby customers can return unused products within 100 days of purchase, with refunds issued to your original payment method.
This gives customers peace of mind and greater confidence in every purchase they make at The Travel Store.

Featured Brand Stories

LOJEL

Photo credit: The Travel Store

Known for its functional yet forward-thinking designs, Japanese brand LOJEL has been redefining modern travel since 1989. One standout innovation is its inverted front-opening luggage (the first of its kind!) made for easier access and better organisation in tight spaces.

Photo credit: The Travel Store

Echolac

Photo credit: The Travel Store

Timeless aesthetics and craftsmanship come to mind at the mention of Echolac, a Japanese heritage brand that’s been around for over 60 years. Since pioneering the world’s first ABS attaché case in 1965, other popular luggage series have been designed including Dynasty, Shogun, and 2021’s Red Dot award-winning design, Celestra Trunk.

Photo credit: The Travel Store

Eminent

Photo credit: The Travel Store

As one of Taiwan’s largest luggage manufacturers for over 40 years, Eminent is considered an innovative leader in the industry. In fact, it was among the first to introduce skating wheels and lifetime warranty), thus transforming luggage mobility as we know it. Pair this with The Travel Store’s lifetime warranty for extra peace of mind wherever you go.

Photo credit: The Travel Store

Verage

Photo credit: The Travel Store

For lightweight and practical designs at an accessible price point, look no further than Verage. This London-based label is growing in popularity and appeals to those seeking added value and functionality for effortless travel.

Photo credit: The Travel Store

Looking to buy Echolac, Eminent, Lojel, and Hush Puppies luggage online in Malaysia through The Travel Store’s official website or physical stores? You can enjoy free shipping on luggage purchases as well as professional luggage repair in Kuala Lumpur at these select outlets.

items.title: A GLIMPSE INTO LIFE AT FOUR POINTS KUALA LUMPUR
items.content:
The experience starts the moment you step into the reimagined comfort of the City Centre. 

You leave the busy streets behind for a space that feels honest and uncomplicated. 

For the family traveller or the urban explorer, everything you need is exactly where it should be. 

Sunlight pours through floor-to-ceiling windows, illuminating a sanctuary of minimalist calm. 

It is a place that values your time as much as your comfort. 


Photo credit: Four Points
A TABLE FOR THE FAMILY

As the morning light fills The Mesh, families gather for a breakfast that feels like home but better. 

This is the social heart of the hotel, where local flavours and international comfort meet. 

The lobby hums with a quiet, social rhythm that invites you to linger. 

As the day unfolds, the dining story expands to the bold spices of Sichuan Kitchen or relaxed bites at the H2O Bar & Grill. 

Whether it’s a quick coffee before exploring or a full family dinner using your daily dining credit, the focus is always on good food and great company.


Photo credit: Four Points

FINDING THE JOY

The hotel is designed to be more than just a stay; it’s an escape for all ages. 

Evenings here are defined by a seamless transition from work to play. 

The outdoor pool area serves as the ultimate urban playground, where kids can splash while parents take in the skyline views. 

Through the M Passport program, little explorers are kept busy with curated activities, turning a simple staycation into a memorable adventure. 

It’s about finding those moments of calm and play amid the city’s fast pace.

 Photo credit: Four Points 

A SPACE TO CALL HOME

Inside the rooms, the focus is on genuine comfort and intelligent space. 

The Family Suites are a standout, offering spacious connecting units with dedicated themed bedrooms that capture a child’s imagination. 

Every detail, from the cosy bedding to the special welcome amenities, is designed to make the transition from travelling to relaxing instant. 

It is a functional, stylish sanctuary that ensures every member of the family has the room they need to breathe.

Photo credit: Four Points

AT THE CENTER OF IT ALL

The beauty of the Four Points location is its proximity to the best of Kuala Lumpur.

Guests are positioned perfectly to explore the city’s iconic landmarks or navigate the nearby business districts. 

You are never more than a few steps away from the city's best hidden gems and culinary treasures.

It’s the ideal middle ground—offering the perks of the Marriott Bonvoy program and easy access to the city's energy, all while providing a comfortable base to return to at the end of the day.

Photo credit: Four Points

EXPERIENCE THE FAMILY JOY RETREAT

Escape and create unforgettable memories. 

Book your stay through December 30, 2026, to enjoy complimentary breakfast, daily dining credits, and exclusive Bonvoy member discounts.
